modelingNotes: Terrace on the Park (the 1964 World's Fair Port Authority heliport) — original procedural geometry, CC0-1.0. bun generators/terrace-on-the-park.ts

Authoring frame: x along the long side of the OSM outline (way/284860789), y across it, z up, metres. Catalog bearing 68.5°, anchor at the outline's centroid. The outline is a 64 × 49 m rounded rectangle and 43 m tall.

Four pylons stand at the middle of the four sides, so each elevation reads as a "T": a dark glazed slot runs up the face of each pylon into the box's lower fascia. The glass-walled box sits on top, with a round lower level hanging under its centre, a slightly projecting roof deck (the old helipad) and a small mechanical penthouse.
Everything is authored flat-shaded and then smoothed with a crease, so the 45° chamfers and rounded corners shade softly while right angles stay crisp.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "terrace-on-the-park", model "terrace-on-the-park"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/terrace-on-the-park.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
